editionLabel: SimplyFun English rules linked from product SKU SF162
firstPlayerRule: Choose a game first. In Multiplication Zones, the first person to multiply their age by two starts. In Field of Hundreds, the first person to add 100 + 90 + 10 starts.
houseFallback: If the official instruction leaves an unresolved tie or cannot be applied, agree to choose randomly. This is this site's suggested house rule.
clarifications: The two sides of the gameboard have different opening criteria. Use the one for the game being played.
In Multiplication Zones, later rounds pass the starting role clockwise.
